experimental_design.evidence: inferred: Mass spectrometry data were processed using MSFragger via FragPipe with default parameters. For downstream analysis, Perseus was used. The MaxLFQ intensity values were log2-transformed and filtered to include only proteins detected in at least two replicates. Missing values were imputed from a normal distribution. Statistical analysis was performed using a two-sample t-test, with a permutation-based FDR applied (S0 parameter = 0.1)
